## About
RJR Radiator is one of the largest shops of our kind in the Greater-Cincinnati area. We serve many different types of customers, from the retail, drive-in customer to the large, industrial customer.
Ray Trammel is our president and founder, Wayne Petrey is our service manager, and Jeff Trammel handles sales and service. We try to keep a clean, friendly place and do the kind of work that gets your car or equipment running cool again.
Customers rate us 4.8 from 76 Google reviews.

## Services
- Industrial and automotive radiators: Repair and service for radiators on cars, trucks and industrial equipment.
- Heavy duty heat exchangers: Service for heavy duty heat exchangers used by industrial customers.
- Oil coolers: Oil cooler service for automotive and industrial equipment.
- Shell & tube bundles: Service for shell and tube bundles.
- Charge coolers and hot water coils: We also work on air charge coolers and hot water coils.
- Air-conditioning service: A full line of air-conditioning service for auto, light truck, and industrial equipment.
- New radiator core: New radiator cores, including for classic cars. One reviewer said their Pierce-Arrow runs great and cool after the work.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on industrial equipment or just cars?
A: Both. We serve everyone from the drive-in customer to the large, industrial customer.

Q: How long does a repair take?
A: It depends on the job. One reviewer had her Model A radiator ready the next day.

Q: What is your phone number?
A: Call us at 513-563-2230.

## What customers say
- "RJR Radiator saved the day!
I had a new radiator installed recently by my home shop, and on our first trip out of town it started leaking antifreeze and the engine was running hot. I was able to limp to the downtown Cincinnati area where we had arrangements to stay for 2 nights. We searched google for radiator repair shops and after reading reviews we settled on RJR.
We called RJR first thing the next morning to make sure they could get us in the same day, then arranged for AAA to tow our vehicle there.
After the tow, our SUV was in RJR‘s hands around 10AM.
Jeff and Joe took great care of our vehicle. They communicated throughout the day regarding the status. We lucked out and the (new) radiator was fine, but the hoses were not hooked up properly, and one hose needed replaced. After they made the proper connections they pressurized the radiator and discovered the water pump was failing. They were able to locate a new water pump and repressurized the system by about 4PM. We picked it up around 5PM and the rest of our trip continued on as planned with no other car trouble!
Jeff and Joe went over everything that they did to our SUV and had some photographs of the problems they found.
We are very grateful of the quality of the work and their willingness to complete such a high quality repair in a timely manner!
These guys are great! I would absolutely recommend them to anyone!" (Travis Keller, 5/5)
- "RJR Radiator did a super job on my Chevette and Cadillac radiators - flushed and silver soldered - both work great - no leaks.  I very highly recommend Jeff and Joe Joe at RJR Radiator - they are very knowledgeable and helpful - 5 star rating - and am telling all of my friends about their great company! John - Middletown" (John Barton, 5/5)
- "Our 1930 Ford Model A radiator had 6 blockages, so we took it to RJR.  They flushed it out and repaired a minor leak in overflow tube.  That freed up all but 1 blockage.  Had it ready next day for reasonable fee.  They also do more involved repairs if needed.  Highly recommend!" (Amy Schroeder, 5/5)
- "RJR installed a new radiator core in our 1936 Pierce-Arrow. Jeff & Joe recommended a replacement core with 33% increased flow capacity, the car runs great and best of all cool. Would recommend highly." (Stu Blair, 5/5)
- "R-J-R are great! Took care of me right away at a fair price!..great company" (Adam Strickland, 5/5)
